prompt:
小红书社媒卡。排版采用图下文上结构，下方是高度概括的角色或场景图，上方是主题文案；整张图不设置大标题，图文之间不设置明显界线，让视觉自然衔接。使用纯色背景，保留较多留白空间，整体构图简单。

本次输入：【填写画幅、标题、主视觉、各区短文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use a text-above-image layout, with a highly simplified character or scene illustration below and the theme copy above. Do not include a prominent headline or title. Do not add a visible boundary between the image and text; let them flow together naturally. Use a solid-color background, generous negative space, and a simple overall composition.

Inputs: [Provide aspect ratio, headline, main visual, and short copy for each section].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
